description: File a new featury request in a project, as the key's owner. Goes through the standard triage: exact-title dedup (returns the existing open ticket on a dupe), area resolution, and a best-effort AI reality read. Semantic near-duplicates of the new ticket are returned as possibleDuplicates (best-effort, may be empty), each with the live twin's ticketId, refCode, title and similarity (0-1). When one is genuinely the same ask, absorb the new filing instead of leaving both: merge_requests with ticketId = the id returned here and parentTicketId = the twin's ticketId. Pass feature to place it on the map, and feedback to attach people's notes (see link_feedback). existing is true when an open request with the same title was already there: nothing new was made, and the feedback went to it. feedback is null when none was passed, or when attaching failed after the request was made: then call link_feedback with the same ids. Pass errorGroup to file the bug for an error group from list_error_groups: one bug per group, so existing is true when the group already has one, and the bug goes on the group's feature.

body.description: Repro steps for a bug; the ask + rationale for a request

errorGroup.description: An error group id from list_error_groups. ENGINEER+. kind must be BUG, the title at most 120 characters, and no feature. Without body or severity, featury's draft for the group fills them in. Write the title and body in your own words: one that repeats the error's saved messages is refused.

feature.description: A feature id from list_features, or a feature key from your code such as "search"

feedback.description: Feedback ids to attach, from list_feedback. MANAGER+ when set. Write the title and body in your own words: one that repeats 8 words in a row from the feedback, or all of a short note, is refused.

kind.description: BUG for a defect, REQUEST for a feature/change ask
